name: snapsats
description: Bitcoin you can text. A wallet that opens when they tap.

justifications.@cashu/cashu-ts: The money layer. Cashu protocol client — we do not write a mint client. Cannot be deleted.
justifications.vite: Dev server plus the bundler that emits the one-file product. Named in DEVELOPMENT.md's toolchain cap.
justifications.vite-plugin-singlefile: Required so dist/ is one index.html. Without it Vite emits many assets and we fail the one-file rule.
justifications.vitest: The test runner named in the prompt. Same family as Vite — no extra test stack.
